Prefer your custom mask, keep a pack’s own mask, or fill missing masks with HyperOS4.
Remove the imported mask and return to automatic selection.
When adaptation is enabled, an imported custom mask takes priority. Otherwise, keep the pack’s own mask; if it is missing, use the built-in HyperOS4 mask.
Turning adaptation off preserves the pack’s own configuration and stops adding custom or default masks. Your imported file is kept.

Choose an XML file up to 16 KB, with IconTransform as its root and a Config element whose name is ConfigIconMask and whose value is a nonempty path in a 100 × 100 viewport. PNG, SVG and dynamic-icon manifest files are not mask files.
A mask changes the outline only. It does not add animation to static icons or replace a dynamic icon’s own layers.
Previews refresh after a change. To change icons already applied to the system, update or regenerate the icon pack and apply it again.
Only the imported custom mask will be removed. Icon packs and downloaded resources stay on this device. Packs will use their own masks, with the default mask filling gaps when enabled.
Automatic filling, imports and visual comparison
The same icons are rendered in all three columns. These previews do not change your settings, download resources or apply a theme.
Packs with special legacy transforms keep their own rules, so some columns may look the same.
No local icon packs to compare. Install or import a pack first.
